scope: Compression algorithm settings only. LLaMA3-8B and Qwen3-8B were not present in every original paper; those rows are official-implementation setting transfers, not same-model paper reproductions.

dense_fp16_same_checkpoint_baseline.model_coverage: same released base checkpoint as the compressed row
dense_fp16_same_checkpoint_baseline.note: This is the uncompressed control, not a compression-paper setting. It must use the exact source checkpoint, revision and evaluation protocol paired with each compressed row.

wanda_iclr2024_c4_128x2048_seed0_unstruc.model_coverage: official algorithm setting transfer to LLaMA3-8B/Qwen3-8B

sparsegpt_icml2023_c4_128x2048_seed0_uns.model_coverage: official algorithm setting transfer to LLaMA3-8B/Qwen3-8B

compression.algorithm: full input Hessian, Cholesky inverse, blockwise error compensation

gptq_for_llama_c4_w4_asymmetric_actorder.model_coverage: official GPTQ-for-LLaMA setting transfer to LLaMA3-8B/Qwen3-8B
gptq_for_llama_c4_w4_asymmetric_actorder.note: The original GPTQ paper covered OPT/BLOOM; GPTQ-for-LLaMA supplies the LLaMA command with C4, W4, act-order and true-sequential. Its --sym flag is opt-in and the documented W4 command does not enable it, so this strict profile uses the official asymmetric default. The official script's data loader uses 128 random 2048-token C4 windows with seed 0.

awq_mlsys2024_pile_w4_g128_grid20.model_coverage: The pinned official LLM-AWQ README gives a LLaMA3-8B W4g128 command. Qwen3-8B is not named by that recipe, so its row is an official-setting transfer and not a same-model paper reproduction.
awq_mlsys2024_pile_w4_g128_grid20.note: The pinned LLM-AWQ entrypoint calls run_awq with pileval, 128 samples and sequence length 512; its LLaMA3-8B README command uses W4 and group size 128 with zero-point enabled by default. LLMCBench realizes the same settings through AutoAWQ and verifies its actual pileval shuffle seed (42) and scale-search grid (20) before a strict run. Qwen3-8B remains an explicitly labelled setting transfer.

smoothquant_w8a8_pile_validation_512_sen.model_coverage: The pinned official repository does not provide a LLaMA3-8B or Qwen3-8B model recipe/export. Strict target-model rows are blocked rather than treating an algorithm transfer or third-party recipe as an original-paper setting.

LLaMA3-8B.reason: Pinned official repository exposes OPT-focused export_int8_model.py and no LLaMA3-8B recipe with calibration provenance and alpha.

Qwen3-8B.reason: Pinned official repository provides no Qwen3-8B recipe, calibration provenance or alpha.

smoothquant_w8a8_pile_validation_512_sen.note: This record preserves the paper-level W8A8/Pile/512-sentence setting but cannot authorize either requested target model until an official target-model recipe is published.

omniquant_w4a16_wikitext2_128x2048_epoch.model_coverage: The pinned official repository has LLaMA/LLaMA-2/OPT/Falcon/Mixtral scripts but no LLaMA3-8B or Qwen3-8B target-model recipe. Strict target-model rows are blocked.

LLaMA3-8B.reason: Pinned official repository contains no LLaMA3-8B script or export recipe.

Qwen3-8B.reason: Pinned official repository contains no Qwen3-8B script or export recipe.

compression.group_size: per-channel unless a g128 variant is explicitly selected

omniquant_w4a16_wikitext2_128x2048_epoch.note: The paper's W4A16 result uses 20 epochs. Group size is left per-channel for the base W4A16 profile; use a distinct protocol for W4A16g128. This does not establish a target-model recipe for LLaMA3-8B or Qwen3-8B.
